author.name: Ada Lovelace
author.notable_contributions: Wrote the first published algorithm intended for a machine — Babbage's Analytical Engine.

quotes.text: That brain of mine is something more than merely mortal; as time will show.

author.name: Grace Hopper
author.role: Computer scientist · US Navy rear admiral
author.notable_contributions: Built the first compiler (A-0), drove the creation of COBOL, and popularized the term "debugging".

quotes.text: The most dangerous phrase in the language is, 'we've always done it this way.'
quotes.source: Widely documented in her public lectures and interviews

quotes.text: It's easier to ask forgiveness than it is to get permission.
quotes.source: Interview; widely cited in profiles of Hopper

author.name: Hedy Lamarr
author.notable_contributions: Co-invented a frequency-hopping spread-spectrum system, a foundation for modern wireless communication.

quotes.text: The brains of people are more interesting than the looks, I think.

author.name: Katherine Johnson
author.notable_contributions: Calculated trajectories for NASA's first crewed spaceflights, including John Glenn's orbital mission.

quotes.text: Like what you do, and then you will do your best.

author.name: Maryam Mirzakhani
author.notable_contributions: First woman to win the Fields Medal, for work on the dynamics and geometry of Riemann surfaces.

quotes.text: The beauty of mathematics only shows itself to more patient followers.

author.name: Radia Perlman
author.notable_contributions: Invented the Spanning Tree Protocol, foundational to modern Ethernet networks.

quotes.text: The world should have so many female engineers that it wouldn't be at all noteworthy.
